    rows.forEach((row) => {

      if (typeCell) {
        const text = typeCell.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        const className = CLASS_MAP[text];

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const containerSelector = ".portlet-bin-collection-day-finder";

  const DAYS = ["Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday"];

  const CLASS_MAP = {
    "Refuse Collection (General Rubbish)": "bin-icon-gr",
    "Recycling Collection": "bin-icon-mr",
    "Food Waste Collection": "bin-icon-fw",
    "Garden Waste Collection (Brown Bin)": "bin-icon-gw",
    "Paper And Card Collection": "bin-icon-pc",
    "Clinical Waste Collection": "bin-icon-cw"
  };

  function formatTable(table) {
    const rows = table.querySelectorAll("tr");

    rows.forEach((row) => {

      const typeCell = row.querySelector("td:nth-child(1)");
      if (typeCell) {
        const text = typeCell.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        const className = CLASS_MAP[text];

        if (className && !typeCell.classList.contains(className)) {
          typeCell.classList.add(className);
        }
      }

      const cell = row.querySelector("td:nth-child(3)");
      if (!cell) return;

      let text = cell.textContent.trim();
      if (!text) return;

      text = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ");

      const weekMatch = text.match(new RegExp(`(${DAYS.join("|")})\\s*Week\\s*(\\d)`, "i"));
      if (weekMatch) {
        cell.textContent = `${weekMatch[1]} - Week ${weekMatch[2]}`;
        return;
      }

      const fortnightMatch = text.match(new RegExp(`(${DAYS.join("|")})\\s*fortnightly`, "i"));
      if (fortnightMatch) {
        cell.textContent = `${fortnightMatch[1]} - Fortnightly`;
        return;
      }

      const dayOnlyMatch = text.match(new RegExp(`^(${DAYS.join("|")})$`, "i"));
      if (dayOnlyMatch) {
        cell.textContent = `Every ${dayOnlyMatch[1]}`;
      }
    });
  }

  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    const container = document.querySelector(containerSelector);
    if (!container) return;

    const table = container.querySelector("table");
    if (!table) return;

    const hasRows = table.querySelector("td:nth-child(3)");
    if (!hasRows) return;

    formatTable(table);

    clearInterval(interval);

  }, 300);
});
